name: low-snr-counterexample

settings.snrConvention: received useful signal energy / expected total useful-window noise energy; equals per-tone SNR for equal-energy tones

resources.cConvention: rounded teaching constant, not exact SI c
resources.bandwidthConvention: N*deltaF nominal DFT bandwidth; endpoint span differs
resources.endpointPolicy: both endpoints included, interval shorter than 150 m ambiguity period
resources.grossErrorDefinition: abs(estimateM-truthM)>9.375, strictly greater; all attempted trials kept
resources.tiePolicy: choose lowest candidate within 64*binary64_epsilon*max(1,maxScore) of maxScore
resources.targetPresence: assumed; no absent-target trials, detection threshold, or detection claim

limits: finite fixed pseudo-random trials; no universal ranking or confidence claim
two grid estimators; truth is continuous, estimator is not continuous optimization
no detection, multi-target resolution, Doppler, timing error, clutter, or calibration claim
